exercise.instruction: Write the program: include <vector> and <algorithm>. Create std::vector<int> nums = {3, 1, 4, 1, 5, 9, 2}, sort it ascending with std::sort(nums.begin(), nums.end()), then print each number on its own line using a range-based for loop.
hints: Hint 3: for (int n : nums) { std::cout << n << std::endl; }

quiz.question: How do you test whether std::find succeeded?
options: The result is not equal to end()
